title: Don Syme - The Agentic Repository Automation Revolution - AI Native DevCon June 2026
description:
Agentic repository automation is reshaping software development by combining Continuous AI (CAI) with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD). These automated workflows proactively enhance, clean, and verify code, shifting teams' focus to strategic tasks. It sounds like magic, but it's real. Developers are seeing floors of wizards at work, casting coding spells that materialize improvements overnight.

Don Syme, a key figure driving these changes, works with GitHub Next, a team at Microsoft Research in Cambridge. Known for his contributions to F# and Copilot, Syme's role is transforming how we think about development tools. By weaving continuous AI into the SDLC, he ensures teams don't just wield magic wands but use them with purpose. His insights offer a glimpse into how agentic workflows are not just future concepts, but are actively reshaping daily engineering tasks.

What we cover:
• Repository automation with GitHub Agentic Workflows
• How is continuous code improvement changing daily engineering tasks?
• Automated performance and repository maintenance enhancements
• The critical role of continuous fault analysis in modern development
• Implementing automated formal verification within existing CI/CD frameworks
